patch_list: A fresh guest account has no privacyPolicy/termsOfService flags, so the app would open the consent screen right after the splash. This disables that check.
Lands on the home screen instead of the onboarding funnel: the app keeps using the anonymous guest account it already creates in the background.
Makes the app always behave as if an active subscription exists: premium workouts, yoga stories, recipes, songs and downloads are unlocked.
